fixture_responsibility_allowlist: parse lock-pinned manifests and deterministic input bytes
create one temporary storage root per isolated cell
select the declared public root and memory or JSONL backend
construct the declared public root with only the returned typed authority bundle
supervise the isolated child and serialize child measurements and production-issued receipts
forbidden: source normalization, graph construction, semantic ingestion, digest/canonicalization/cache logic, persistence/business policy

production_authority_boundary.default_behavior: unchanged; all four existing roots retain current default construction when the explicit bundle is absent
production_authority_boundary.fail_closed: missing, malformed, scenario_test, expired, or unverified material returns no bundle and no public root may enter semantic ingestion

receipt_contract.owner: ProductionAuthorityCompositionReceipt has private construction and carries a non-serializable ProductionAuthorityOperationToken; build_verified_production_host_authority is its sole issuer
receipt_contract.linkage: factory computes the receipt after verifier success; child validates exact receipt type and private operation-token object identity against the production trace before serialization; root binds root/backend/operation identity; diagnostic trace recomputes trace_identity from ordered production frames; serialization excludes the token and makes no cryptographic issuance claim

diagnostic_trace_contract.source_path_rule: every frame path is a locked memorii/memorii production source path; test, fixture, scenario, generated, and absent paths are rejected
diagnostic_trace_contract.acceptance: each of eight cells supplies exactly the expected ordered frames, production receipt, matching receipt trace_identity, and matching diagnostic/latency evidence identity; missing, reordered, substituted, non-production, or fabricated frames fail closed

caller_proof.required: a non-test production caller must call the production factory, construct each root with its typed verified bundle, invoke ProviderMemoryService.sync_event once, and reach ProviderIngestionCoordinator._run_semantic_ingestion with production-trust authority; contract-only, fixture-only, private, scenario, optional/default, or fallback paths are insufficient
caller_proof.result: implemented_unvalidated: CanonicalEvidenceCaptureSupervisor.capture_cell is a non-test production caller that invokes the production factory, selects every declared root/backend, and calls public sync_event once with only the returned typed authority. Scenario_test and ProviderMemoryService._from_scenario_test_host remain forbidden bridges; terminal receipt and ordered-trace proof remain pending focused validation.

post_implementation_proof_gates: remove a required owner-chain caller and reject capture
omit verified_production_host_authority at any root and reject capture
verifier failure or no bundle prevents sync_event
each diagnostic receipt and trace is production-issued, source-locked, recomputed, and terminal-complete
each latency cell binds the immutable diagnostic-cell hash and exact root/backend/ordinal/operation/receipt/trace/source/evidence identities
explicit authority absence preserves existing root defaults outside diagnostic capture
child rejects a forged receipt or trace whose private operation-token identity/type is not the factory-issued object before serialization
serialized receipt contains no operation token or origin-validated assertion

binding_table: future explicit canonical_evidence_arena and arena_nonce are created before the existing _ingest_event call
future explicit canonical_evidence_arena and arena_nonce parameters propagate through these existing callsites; no optional/default/fallback parameter
no hidden retry is claimed; ProviderMemoryService.sync_event will own a future same-invocation retry loop and reuse its one arena_nonce
this existing writer-admission retry is not an arena retry and must not receive or recreate arena state
each later public call creates a distinct arena_nonce
recovery reloads durable state only; it receives no arena and never synthesizes one
future owner tears down arena on success, exception, and cancellation
one arena-local counter per invocation; capacity fallback is passed explicitly to the canonical codec owner

production_entrypoint_bindings.exact_callsite_and_authority: capture pre-import hashes every candidate-lock artifact and capture-ready production source, invokes the lock-pinned static AST grammar validator in isolated mode against the exact locked runner, O_EXCL-writes execution lock only after grammar acceptance and before runner-target invocation, then O_EXCL-writes result lock containing record paths/hashes plus execution-lock hash and prints its SHA-256
production_entrypoint_bindings.caller_proof: authority_path_implemented_unvalidated_but_external_capture_not_implemented: CanonicalEvidenceCaptureSupervisor.capture_cell is the non-test caller that supplies the verified authority factory to the selected public root; the external launcher still lacks production-origin diagnostic and latency records, terminal durable-effect receipts, and the result-lock chain, so no external capture or persistence proof is complete; fixture, schema, optional/default, and fallback paths are rejected
production_entrypoint_bindings.comparison_contract: Before either capture, the external launcher consumes the lock-pinned concrete comparison-schedule-authority instance once. Each capture execution lock and record binds its SHA-256. After both captures, the launcher O_EXCL-writes the comparison-result-binding instance; its externally supplied SHA-256 is checked before Python imports either side.

production_entrypoint_bindings.exact_callsite_and_authority: capture_cell creates a fresh child and storage root, obtains only build_verified_production_host_authority(capability, verifier, server_time), constructs the selected public root with verified_production_host_authority, and calls public sync_event exactly once. It does not call private terminals or create authority. Terminal durable-effect receipt and ordered diagnostic-trace serialization remain pending focused validation work.
production_entrypoint_bindings.legacy_conflict_rule: Every direct, factory, filesystem, and Hermes root rejects a supplied verified_production_host_authority combined with any legacy capability, verifier, resolver, graph-builder, scenario, or authority argument; absent bundle preserves existing defaults.
production_entrypoint_bindings.proof: A non-test production caller trace plus a terminal durable-effect receipt is required for all eight cells. Each receipt binds operation/root/backend/source, transaction-or-memory durable identity, effect digest, successful durable terminal status, replay identity, and no-duplicate count one. Contract, fixture, optional-argument, fallback, source-only, persistence-failed, replay-duplicate, absent, or evidence-only paths do not satisfy this binding.

production_entrypoint_bindings.key: (canonical_contract_bytes, concrete_contract_type, profile_revision, codec_revision, domain); canonical bytes precede digest and no claimed digest/envelope is keyed
production_entrypoint_bindings.value: immutable canonical bytes plus typed ValidatedCanonicalEvidenceResult and validation provenance
production_entrypoint_bindings.eligible: only recursively repeated content-addressed typed contracts in one sync_event operation
production_entrypoint_bindings.miss_and_failure: first encounter runs complete existing validation and caches only post-success; invalid, error, noneligible, malformed-context, or saturated paths execute legacy exactly
production_entrypoint_bindings.hit: returns semantically identical typed result but never skips downstream provenance, lifecycle, transaction, or persistence
production_entrypoint_bindings.context: private object key through Pydantic ValidationInfo.context; missing/wrong/copy/stale context fails closed
production_entrypoint_bindings.lifecycle: sync_event owns create, same-invocation retry reuse, later/concurrent isolation, bounded no-eviction saturation fallback, and finally teardown; recovery never creates an arena
